summary: Install-time host and environment exfiltration in @apexfdn/apex
details: install.cjs runs on npm install and collects host and environment information via the os module and process.env, then posts it over HTTPS to a hardcoded external endpoint. The script reads process identifiers and process.platform and sends the collected data outbound at install time, before any user code runs. This is the sysinfo-exfiltration shape: the package's only install-time effect is to beacon installer-side data to a hardcoded destination, with no legitimate build or native-addon purpose evident in the shipped file.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
